text:
Priya: Dropped an 'obsidian' dark theme iteration in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/obsidian-pass. Main intent: ultra-low glow panels (#07080A), warm surface lift (#0D0F11), and higher-lightness accents for micro UI. Can folks scan charts, sparklines, and focus styles?
Nate: Sparkline thumbnails look washed at 8px height. The stroke is fine on 2x, but on normal screens the thin stroke disappears.
Omar: Can we add a 1px outer stroke (semi-opaque) to sparklines for small sizes? Eg SVG tweak: stroke="var(--accent)" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-opacity="0.92" and a faint outline stroke="#0A0A0A" stroke-width="0.5".
Priya: Good idea. I worry about double strokes adding visual weight. Maybe only outline on hover/selected.
Nate: Hover-only is fine. But selected state needs to be unmistakable. Maybe selected uses accent-700 and a subtle glow (box-shadow) to separate from baseline.
Li: Accessibility: keyboard focus ring on cards is nearly invisible in current dark base. Need a 3:1 contrast on focus indicator per a11y patterns for non-text controls. Suggest focus ring color #3FA9FF with 2px solid outline and 6px focus-offset.
Coco: Add a high-contrast toggle in the accessibility menu that increases chart contrast and swaps gradients for flat colors. Many customers in enterprise prefer explicit high-contrast mode.
Omar: For stacked area charts, colors need more luminance separation. Proposing a perceptual ramp using L*a*b lightness deltas rather than purely hue changes. This helps deuteranopia and low-vision users.
Priya: Agree. I'll generate a Lab-based ramp and paste swatches in figma (labels: obsidian-accent-100..900).
Nate: Microcopy nit: the toggle reads "High contrast" but keyboard users might think it impacts text only. Change to "High contrast (UI & charts)".
Li: Also add aria-pressed state on the toggle and an accessible description: "Increases color contrast for chart elements and UI controls".
Priya: CSS snippet I'm going to try for focus ring: ```css
.card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3FA9FF; outline-offset: 6px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(63,169,255,0.08); }
```
Omar: For JSON code blocks we should avoid using orange for keys. Proposal: keys = #BFA8F6 (muted lavender), strings = #9BD88B (soft green), numbers = #8EC5FF. Keeps errors red still obvious.
Coco: Quick UX thought: Add a "Theme contrast" slider in advanced settings so users can tweak accent intensity. Saves us from shipping multiple theme variants.
Priya: Nice—will prototype a small control. If anyone objects to slider UX for new users we'll fall back to presets.
Theme-Bot: Design review created: DR-4310 - "Obsidian theme: sparklines, focus states, and high-contrast option" assigned to @Priya. Due in 72h.
Nate: Leaving a few pinned comments in figma around the mini-chart heights and selected state.
Li: I'll run through VoiceOver/NVDA quick pass after the updated tokens land.
Priya: Thanks team 1F44D I'll post updated tokens + changelog later today.
